async def act(page):
    # Fill the Project name textbox with 'Hello'
    project_name_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Project name", exact=True)
    await project_name_textbox.fill("Hello")
    
    # Wait for the Save changes button to be clickable (not disabled)
    save_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Save changes", exact=True).first
    await save_button.wait_for(state="visible", timeout=10000)
    # Check if the button is disabled and wait if necessary
    while await save_button.is_disabled():
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)  # Wait a bit and check again
    
    # Click the Save changes button
    await save_button.click()
    
    # Wait for any navigation or state change after saving
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
